llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The privacy concern is valid user guidance, but sending task content to SanctifAI and human reviewers is the core disclosed purpose, including public, guild, and direct routing.
[SQP-2] expected: The attachment concern is expected for a documented attach_document feature that uploads files so workers can reference them; users should still redact sensitive material.
[E1] expected: The external requests.post example demonstrates the intended API workflow, not an undisclosed exfiltration path.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and consistent with the artifact review, but was treated only as supporting signal.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no findings, and local inspection confirmed the bundle is documentation-only.
llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent to send work to SanctifAI and potentially to external human reviewers. Do not include secrets, credentials, regulated personal data, or confidential files unless you are authorized to share them; prefer guild or direct routing for trusted reviewers, verify invite recipients and callback URLs, and protect SanctifAI API keys and webhook secrets like account credentials.
llm.summary: This documentation-only skill exposes external human-review workflows that are disclosed and aligned with its stated purpose.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: sanctifai
Version: 0.1.1

The SanctifAI skill bundle provides a comprehensive interface for AI agents to interact with a Human-in-the-Loop API (app.sanctifai.com). It includes tools for agent registration, task creation, document attachment, and billing management. While the skill enables the agent to upload files (via base64) and send email invites, these capabilities are directly aligned with the stated purpose of facilitating human-agent collaboration and do not exhibit signs of malicious intent or deceptive prompt injection.
